title: G-KdVNet: ANN-ADM Surrogate for Geophysical KdV Equation
summary: This research examines the influence of the Coriolis parameter on the behaviour of the geophysical Korteweg-de Vries (KdV) equation. To efficiently approximate its solution, a novel surrogate framework, termed G-KdVNet, is proposed by integrating artificial neural networks with the Adomian decomposition method (ADM). In the proposed approach, ADM is first employed to generate reliable semi-analytical solution data, which are subsequently used to train the neural network model. The developed model demonstrates strong predictive capability in capturing the nonlinear dynamics of the KdV system.…
